study: R10 dose interpolation with composition and within-state components

qc.note: R10 pre-fixed hash-purity rule; the exact thresholds of the original paper are not verified here

split.group: identical SMILES string (hashTable metadata); otherwise the catalog number

atlas.K_rule: per line, choose K in K_candidates maximising the occupancy-weighted mean Pearson correlation of rep1 vs rep2 state occupancy across train-drug conditions; if the difference is < 0.02 take the smaller K; every state must hold >= 2% of fit cells

mmd_bandwidth: median pairwise distance of fit cells per line (train only), fixed
